The sub-answer confirms or refutes capability-gap findings detected in plan-review, with yes meaning the gap is real and no meaning the capability was delivered/exercised
Code-review and plan-review Binary models both inherit asserted_capability_confirmed from the shared _build_binary module and default it to na outside the G6/E4/T3 asserted-capability cohort
E5 byte-identical replay and E6 self-consistency (κ=0.874) must pass before landing; validity/decision must remain unchanged whether the field is absent or na
The change affects only the validity axis and does not bump IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION or introduce cross-field coupling to divergent_implementation
Implementation must fit the existing 800-LOC hard cap in verify_models.py and include unit tests for field registration, na-default behavior, and polarity correctness
